notes: Session 04 goods catalogue. Every base price is anchored to a canonical prices.json line (named in each good's 'anchor'); the anchor is the monthly budget line for the same consumption, so one unit of a monthly good is one adult-month of that consumption. Goods with no prices.json anchor carry 'anchor': null and a SIM MODEL base price, labelled as such (the Session 03 honesty pattern). Market prices (tools/sim/market.py) move around these base prices only on recorded supply/demand signals.
